CREDIT AGREEMENT
MANUFACTURING CO.
Dated: September 2024

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ARTICLE VII - NEGATIVE COVENANTS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Section 7.05. Limitation on Asset Sales and Dispositions.

(a) Permitted Dispositions. The Borrower may make Asset Sales:
    
    (i) in the ordinary course of business (including sales of inventory, obsolete
        equipment, and worn-out assets);
    
    (ii) other Asset Sales in an aggregate fair market value not to exceed
        $500,000,000 in any fiscal year (the "Annual Asset Sale Basket");
    
    (iii) without the consent or approval of any Lender.

(b) Fair Market Value. All Asset Sales must be made for fair market value, as
    determined in good faith by the Board of Directors of the Borrower.

(c) Consideration. At least 75% of the consideration for any Asset Sale must
    consist of cash or Cash Equivalents (with the remaining 25% permitted to be
    non-cash consideration, including promissory notes, earn-outs, or equity).

(d) Mandatory Prepayment. The Net Cash Proceeds of Asset Sales in excess of
    $200,000,000 in the aggregate during any fiscal year shall be applied to
    mandatory prepayment of the Term Loans in accordance with Section 2.05(b).
    
    For clarity, the first $200,000,000 of Net Cash Proceeds in any fiscal year
    may be retained by the Borrower and used for any corporate purpose, including
    investments, acquisitions, restricted payments, or general corporate purposes,
    without any requirement to prepay the Term Loans.

(e) No Restrictions. This Section 7.05 shall not restrict:
    
    (i) sales or dispositions in the ordinary course of business;
    
    (ii) sales of assets that are obsolete, surplus, or no longer useful;
    
    (iii) sales to wholly-owned Restricted Subsidiaries.

LEAKAGE ANALYSIS:
• $500M annual basket - VERY LARGE
• Only $200M sweep threshold - WEAK PROTECTION (only 40% sweep)
• $200M can be retained for any purpose - NO RESTRICTIONS
• 75% cash requirement - ALLOWS 25% NON-CASH CONSIDERATION
• Fair market value standard - VALUATION GAMING RISK
• No lender consent required - UNILATERAL BORROWER ACTION
• Ordinary course exemption - POTENTIAL FOR ABUSE
• ASSET SALE LEAKAGE RISK SCORE: 7.5/10.0 (HIGH)
